item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second silent 16:9 motion-design advertisement for ClearDay, a fictional daily planning app. Original invented demo interface, not a real screenshot. Calm premium blue-and-white aesthetic, generous white space, soft pale blue background, navy type, rounded white task cards, restrained soft shadows. Straight-on static view of a large desktop app interface; no people, no device mockup, no camera movement. One continuous simple visual transformation. Seconds 0–2: a messy overwhelming cluster of overlapping task cards fills the center, with short English labels such as Email, Walk, Focus, Call, Review. Seconds 2–5.5: the SAME cards gently glide apart and align into a clean spacious daily schedule, three orderly rows under the heading 'Today': '9:00 Focus', '12:00 Walk', '3:00 Review'. Clear visual before-and-after, reassuring fluid motion, not frantic. Seconds 5.5–8: interface softly fades away and reveals a centered large clean navy sans-serif wordmark spelled exactly 'ClearDay' on white, with a small minimal blue rising-sun icon above it. Hold the final branding still and legible through the end. All text in English. Keep copy minimal and large. No other brands, no watermark, no speech, no music, no sound.

opening.text: Could you make an ad for ClearDay, which is a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan? I like the idea because my own to-do lists always seem to get more overwhelming instead of more useful. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen yourself, and the ad should be 8 seconds long in 16:9. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Give it a calm blue-and-white look with no sound, and any other wording is up to you.
